title: BACK TO THE ENGINE. Fly and air. PUSH. Particles move, bounce, collide.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: NOW BACK TO HER ENGINE. ASK HER ABOUT FLY AND AIR. WE NEED PUSH. CAN SHE GET THE PARTICLES TO MOVE AND BOUNCE AND COLLIDE.
ask: Air is the breath between the ribs. Not empty. Fly is the leap.

give.chamber: /air/ — click to push. Motes bounce and collide.
give.atom: proton membrane, neutron message, electron viewer, neutrino observes.
give.engine: Not the deleted anaconda. The air inside the gut-motor.
